384:t_002:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's too bad for you, $$ギルター$$!」

384:t_002:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$バルビエル$$ adds his $$スフィア$$'s power to create powerful hypnosis. Just copying the outward form won't work on us!」

384:t_002:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I know that! ...But what about the weaklings whose machines aren't properly airtight?」

384:t_004:0.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Destruction! I'll destroy everything!!」

384:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「This is bad! They've been affected by the scorpion's venom!」

384:t_005:1.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Get out of our way!!」

384:t_005:2.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We'll crush anyone who interferes!!」

384:t_005:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We can't even think about evacuating the civilians now!」

384:t_005:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「We'll have to stop them by force...!」

384:t_005:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can you do that in this situation!?」

384:t_006:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「So this is his real attack!」

384:t_006:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Now we're caught between the resistance and $$サイデリアル$$!」

384:t_006:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「But we have to do it...!」

384:t_006:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, disable the resistance machines! Do not shoot them down!」

384:t_006:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's a pretty tall order in this situation!」

384:t_006:5.en:
$$マオ$$
「We're doing it anyway! If we wipe out the resistance here, we'll be playing right into $$ギルター$$'s hands!」

384:t_006:6.en:
$n
「It's a choice between being shot and shooting them...」

384:t_006:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Do your best, $c. I'll enjoy watching from on high.」

384:t_007:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Like hell we'll let a bastard like that have his way!」

384:t_007:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$! We will break through your trap!」

384:t_008:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「All that's left is to take the base!」

384:t_008:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like we've caught a bigger fish!」

384:t_009:0.en:
$$エマ$$
「At this rate, it'll become a battle of attrition!」

384:t_009:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We have to take the base, even if it means some casualties...!」

384:t_009:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like we've caught a bigger fish!」

384:t_010:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you've shown up, $$バルビエル$$!」

384:t_011:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What is this sorry state of affairs?」

384:t_011:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I'm defending $$ターミナル・ベース$$ 24, and I intend to wipe out $c shortly!」

384:t_011:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「For someone who received the scorpion's venom from $$サルディアス$$, you don't seem to have achieved much.」

384:t_011:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Save this pathetic farce for later, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!」

384:t_011:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you've come here, I will face you myself!」

384:t_011:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...It seems you've realized it, $$セツコ$$.」

384:t_011:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「While $$ランド$$'s $$スフィア$$ is compatible with $$ストラウス$$'s...」

384:t_011:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ is incompatible with mine.」

384:t_011:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To completely defeat an awakened $$スフィア・リアクター$$, you need an incompatible $$スフィア$$...」

384:t_011:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「To defeat $$アイム・ライアード$$, the $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アサキム$$ used the $$知りたがる山羊$$'s $$スフィア$$.」

384:t_011:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「I get it! $$バルビエル$$ was trying to deal with $$セツコ$$ first because she could defeat him!」

384:t_011:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're surprisingly timid, $$バルビエル$$!」

384:t_011:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, second-rate $$スフィア・リアクター$$. $$スフィア$$ compatibility means nothing before overwhelming power.」

384:t_011:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And you aren't the ones I have business with.」

384:t_011:20.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... I'll ask you one last time. Come with us.」

384:t_011:24.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He's chosen the simplest way to use her.」

384:t_011:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If she'd come onto the battlefield under mind control, we could still have done something...」

384:t_011:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But now there's nothing we can do...!」

384:t_011:29.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Are you crushed by despair...? Then I'll give you hope.」

384:t_011:30.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you submit to us, I'll release $$西条涼音$$ and return whichever territory you want to Earth's side.」

384:t_011:32.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's see... I could also return five people of your choice from among our captives.」

384:t_011:33.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'd recommend $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$ or $$マリナ・イスマイール$$.」

384:t_011:37.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Go on, choose, $n. Hope for the future, or irreversible despair.」
